newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds firm after listless session.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds firm after listless session.

text.p: Portuguese bonds edged higher at the close, although by less than other peripheries, after a quiet day of range trading and dealers said the upside potential was limited.
"The market recovered at the close on the back of Italian BTPs, but there is not much room for upside potential," said one operator.
Another said: "The potential for an increase is limited because 10-year Portuguese bonds show narrow spreads against Bunds, which are falling."
